properties.name: sitmun.client.unsafe-allowed-hosts
properties.description: List of hostnames that are allowed to use unsafe SSL connections. Use '*' to allow all hosts.

properties.name: sitmun.backend.config.url
properties.description: URL for the SITMUN backend configuration API endpoint. This is the URL where the proxy middleware will request configuration data.

properties.name: sitmun.backend.config.secret
properties.description: Secret key for authenticating with the SITMUN backend configuration API. This secret is used in the X-SITMUN-Proxy-Key header.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.url
properties.description: Base URL of the MBTiles generation service. Owned by the middleware; never accepted from clients.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.job-handle-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret for opaque MBTiles job handles. Rotating this key without multi-key support invalidates active jobs.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.job-handle-ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live for opaque MBTiles job handles.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.max-json-bytes
properties.description: Maximum accepted JSON body size in bytes for MBTiles estimate/create requests.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.max-zoom-span
properties.description: Maximum allowed (maxZoom - minZoom) for MBTiles estimate/create requests.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.allowed-srs
properties.description: Allowed SRS values for MBTiles estimate/create requests.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout for upstream MBTiles HTTP calls.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.service-check.enabled
properties.description: When false, OGC forwards still complete and no service-check report is sent.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.service-check.debounce-count
properties.description: Identical classified statuses in a row before a proxy report is posted.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.service-check.debounce-window
properties.description: How long one pending status waits before a proxy report is posted.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.service-check.scan-max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum bytes read by the shared StAX scan on an OGC forward.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.service-check.exception-text-max-length
properties.description: Maximum characters kept from an OGC exception text before classification.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.usage.enabled
properties.description: When false, OGC forwards are not counted.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.usage.flush-interval
properties.description: How often in-memory usage deltas are posted.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.usage.backlog
properties.description: Unsent usage hours older than this are dropped, oldest first.

properties.name: sitmun.mbtiles.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for upstream MBTiles HTTP calls.
